cli_description: MyLAN Host: connects phones to this PC's apps through MyLAN, with no MyLAN code in the apps.
help_run: start the Host (stays on; Ctrl+C to stop)
help_invite: create a one-time invite (15 minutes) for an app
help_approve: approve the phone using this invite code
help_reject: refuse the phone using this invite code
help_secret_stdin: read the app's secret from stdin instead of generating it
running: MyLAN Host running. Invites: python -m host invite <app>. Ctrl+C to stop.
pending_request: Request for "{app}" from {who}. To approve: python -m host approve {code} (to refuse: reject {code})
unknown_app: Unknown app: {app}. List: python -m host apps list
missing_target: Missing the app's URL or id.
app_added: App "{name}" registered as {app} -> {url} (protected: {protected}; secret in header {header})
app_secret: Secret for the app (shown once, the app checks it in header {header}): {secret}
